newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Moos Q1 result exceeds budget.
newsitem.headline: Von Moos Q1 result exceeds budget.

text.p: Swiss steel group Von Moos Holding AG said its first quarter results were slightly above budget and the operating loss had been considerably reduced from the same period last year.
Von Moos also said in a statement that third party sales rose six percent to 178.5 million Swiss francs and operating cash flow was positive compared with a negative flow last year.
Von Moos did not give figures for its first quarter operating or net result, but said a full letter to shareholders would be issued early next week.
It added Connecticut Steel Corp had a gratifying result and an increase in business volume was financed by itself.
